name: ssd-bench-structured-openapi-spec
notes: Structured: OpenAPI 3.1 spec generation for an LLM serving API. Long requirement list, ~640 prompt tokens. Output is YAML.

messages.content:
Generate a complete OpenAPI 3.1 YAML specification for an LLM inference platform API. The spec must cover all of the following endpoints and schemas. Use proper OpenAPI 3.1 syntax including $ref, components/schemas, components/securitySchemes, and requestBody.

Authentication: Bearer token via Authorization header. Define a BearerAuth security scheme. All endpoints require it unless noted.

Endpoints to specify:

1. POST /v1/chat/completions
   Purpose: OpenAI-compatible chat completions (streaming and non-streaming).
   Request body (required): ChatCompletionRequest schema with fields: model (string, required), messages (array of ChatMessage, required, minItems 1), max_tokens (integer, 1–32768, default 512), temperature (number, 0.0–2.0, default 1.0), top_p (number, 0.0–1.0, default 1.0), stream (boolean, default false), seed (integer, nullable), stop (oneOf string or array of strings, nullable).
   ChatMessage schema: role (enum: system, user, assistant, tool), content (oneOf string or array of ContentPart). ContentPart schema: type (enum: text, image_url, audio_url), text (string, nullable), image_url (object with url string and detail enum: low/high/auto), audio_url (object with url string).
   Response 200: ChatCompletionResponse schema with id, object (literal chat.completion), created (integer unix timestamp), model (string), choices (array of ChatChoice), usage (Usage schema). ChatChoice has index, message (ChatMessage), finish_reason (enum: stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter, null). Usage has prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens (all integers), and an optional ssd_hits field (integer, describing prompt-cache SSD hits for this request).
   Stream response: text/event-stream, each chunk is a ChatCompletionChunk with same shape but delta instead of message, and usage only on the final chunk.

2. GET /v1/models
   Purpose: List available models.
   No request body. Response 200: ModelList schema with object (literal list) and data (array of ModelCard). ModelCard: id (string), object (literal model), created (integer), owned_by (string), context_length (integer), supports_vision (boolean), supports_audio (boolean), weight_quant (string), kv_quant_options (array of string).

3. GET /metrics
   Purpose: Prometheus text-format metrics scrape. No auth required.
   Response 200: text/plain; version=0.0.4. No schema (free-form text).

4. GET /health
   Purpose: Liveness probe. No auth required.
   Response 200: { status: ok } JSON object.

5. POST /v1/cache/flush
   Purpose: Flush the RAM prompt-cache for a namespace.
   Request body: { namespace: string (required), scope: enum [ram, ssd, all] (default ram) }.
   Response 200: { flushed: true, namespace: string, scope: string }.
   Response 404: standard ErrorResponse when namespace not found.

Error responses: Define an ErrorResponse schema with error object containing message (string), type (string), param (string nullable), code (string nullable). Use this for 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 429, 500.

Include: info block (title: rMLX Inference API, version: 0.1.0, description: one paragraph), servers block with a placeholder URL https://api.example.com/. Add examples under the ChatCompletionRequest requestBody for a minimal text request and a vision request with an image_url content part.
